10k.note: Antibody discovery technology platform (transgenic animals, single-cell screening, OmniDeep in silico, OmniHub bioinformatics). 107 active partners with 407 active programs as of Dec 31, 2025; 27 OmniAb-derived antibodies in partner clinical development, 2 under regulatory review, 3 approved. All clinical-stage assets are partner-owned.

website.note: Not fetched — issuer is a discovery-services platform with no proprietary clinical pipeline; partner programs are confidential.

ctgov.note: OmniAb is not a trial sponsor; antibodies derived from its platform are sponsored by licensee partners under their own names.

excluded_partner_owned.note: 27 OmniAb-derived antibodies in partner-sponsored clinical development, 2 under regulatory review, 3 commercialized by partners (per FY2025 10-K). Per workflow rule, partner-owned trials are excluded; OmniAb's role is upstream discovery technology licensing with downstream royalties/milestones.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: OmniAb is a pure antibody-discovery technology platform / contract-research-style licensor (transgenic OmniRat/OmniMouse/OmniChicken/OmniFlic, xPloration single-cell screening, OmniDeep, OmniHub). It does not own or sponsor clinical trials; all 27 OmniAb-derived antibodies in clinical development are partner-owned and excluded per workflow cross-reference rules. No proprietary P1/P2/P3 pipeline.
